College Hunks Hauling Junk and Moving is a franchise network doing two businesses — junk removal and local moving — with trained crews and a strong service reputation. Couch Disposal Plus does one thing: furniture pickup, booked and priced online. The comparison, like [our GOT-JUNK breakdown](/blog/junk-removal/couch-disposal-plus-vs-1-800-got-junk/), mostly reduces to pricing model and scope.

## The Structural Differences

**Pricing:** College Hunks, like most traditional haulers, finalizes junk-removal pricing based on volume and the specifics of the job — estimates up front, the binding number confirmed in person. We publish flat per-item prices by ZIP ([from $90 for a standard couch](/pricing/)) that you pay at booking; there is no in-person quoting step to schedule or sit through.

**Scope:** College Hunks' dual model is a real advantage when your job mixes needs — moving some furniture to a new place *and* hauling the rest away is one crew, one visit, and few competitors can do both. We don't move furniture between locations; we remove it, with [donation routing](/donation-pickup/) as the first stop for anything in good condition.

**Who shows up:** franchise employees in branded trucks versus background-checked independent local Loaders dispatched through our platform. Both models are accountable; they're just organized differently — franchise standards on one side, platform vetting and review accountability on the other.

## Choosing Between Them

Pick College Hunks when the job is mixed (move this, junk that), when you're clearing significant volume, or when you want one franchise crew handling a complicated day. Pick flat-rate removal when the job is defined — a couch, a sectional, a few pieces — and you'd rather see the price on your screen than in your driveway. For a single-item pickup, paying a crew-visit premium to be quoted on something a ZIP code already prices is the inefficiency we exist to remove.

Cost-wise, the honest statement is the same one from our [full cost guide](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/): single items favor per-item pricing; big mixed loads favor volume pricing. Neither company repeals that math.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does College Hunks charge by volume?

Their junk-removal pricing is based on how much space items take and job specifics, confirmed on site — standard for traditional haulers. Their moving service prices separately, typically hourly.

### Which is cheaper for one couch?

Flat per-item pricing is usually the economical route for a single item, since there's no visit minimum to absorb. For larger mixed jobs the gap narrows or reverses.

### Does either service donate the furniture?

Both describe donation programs. With us it's the default routing: donatable couches are offered to charity partners before disposal is considered, and [donation pickup](/donation-pickup/) can be booked explicitly.

### Can Couch Disposal Plus move my couch to another address?

No — we remove and route furniture out of your life; we don't relocate it. If you need both moving and removal in one visit, that's the job College Hunks' dual model is built for.
